result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Licensee may assign without consent to Affiliates and M&A successors, Licensor assignments require Licensee consent that may not be unreasonably withheld or delayed and are prohibited to Licensee competitors, and Licensee change of control no longer creates a termination right. It is not fully minimal because the change-of-control provision also prohibits suspension, repricing, or any other modification, protections not required by the playbook. Drafting quality is reduced by the ambiguous reference to “such consent” in the void-assignment sentence and the retained missing punctuation before “Subject to the terms of this Section.”
